title: Duplicator stamp
simLoop: copyForm captures a relative elev(+depth)[+material] delta field against the source footprint's own mean (pure observer, no sim write); pasteForm re-applies that delta field at a new footprint through the same clamp family as berm/mold, depth riding with elev (C-002); material re-stamps only through the existing direct-write path deposit already uses (C-009).
gameLoop: Tool: duplicate — click a source form, then click a destination to re-stamp the same relief elsewhere, multiplying a form the player already sculpted (a ridge, a basin lip) as a terrain cause (A-005), not painted architecture or copied ecology.
notebookSeed: I copied the ridge I shaped by the cove and set it down again at the inlet — the same form, twice, not a new one nature grew.
